summary: Recursive tree-activity check. Reads two child pointers (this+0x44, this+0x4C) and recurses TreeActiveCheck(child, 1) when present, returning -1 when a recursion reports true (the second child recursion is additionally gated on flag a2). Then walks a sibling list from the head at this+0x204 following next pointers at node+0x10, returning -1 if any node satisfies SceneNodeChildrenClear (0x0054D030); returns 0 when the list is exhausted.

operations.description: Read the child pointer at this+0x44 (a1[17]); if non-null, recurse TreeActiveCheck(child, 1) and return -1 when it returns non-zero.
Read the child pointer at this+0x4C (a1[19]); if non-null and flag a2 is set, recurse TreeActiveCheck(child, 1) and return -1 when it returns non-zero.
Read the sibling list head at this+0x204 (a1[129]); if null, return 0.
Walk the sibling list following the next pointer at node+0x10 while SceneNodeChildrenClear(v5) returns false; if the next pointer becomes null, return 0.
Return -1 when a sibling node satisfies SceneNodeChildrenClear.

unresolved: Semantics of flag a2: it gates only the second child recursion.
The -1 vs 0 return convention and the meaning of 'active' relative to SceneNodeChildrenClear are not established; the -1 branch fires when a node's children are reported clear.
The field base *(this+0x214) for the +0x10 next pointer differs textually from the sibling list head at this+0x204; the node object layout beyond the next pointer is unknown.
Exact behavior of SceneNodeChildrenClear (0x0054D030) is unknown.
